title: A square filter in a round hole
caption:
Apollo 13's spare CO2 filters were square. The lifeboat's sockets were round. Engineers fixed it with bags, cardboard, a sock and duct tape. 🧦
Full video: [LINK]
What would you have used?
sources: NASA History, Apollo 13 'Houston, we've had a problem' (EP-76); Report of Apollo 13 Review Board (1970)
